arStrings.szText: ...Philios mourned the loss of his friends. He wandered aimlessly, until one day he stumbled upon Askarra tilling Hefaetrus’ fields.
Formal, an entry in a historical record.

A woman of great brilliance and compassion, Askarra had taken up Hefaetrus’ mantle. Philios stayed to help, quickly falling in love. Askarra gave birth to twin girls, Antia and Seryn, who both inherited their father’s adventurous spirit...
Formal, an entry in a historical record.
